```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

Principal component analysis of SBS96 mutational spectra at the level of
phylogenetic branches, followed by unsupervised clustering in PC space, to test
whether branches separate by colibactin (SBS88) status without being told the
labels.

## Setup

### Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(mclust)    # adjustedRandIndex
```

### Input data

```{r load-data}
# SigProfilerMatrixGenerator output:
#   <project>/01_Input/output/SBS/paediatric_branches_both.SBS96.all
contexts <- read.table("../Signatures/paediatric_sbs_branches.SBS96.all",
                       header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

crypt_pileup_classification <- read.csv("../Data/crypt_pileup_classification.csv")
```

### Branch annotation

```{r branch-labels}
branch_labels <- crypt_pileup_classification %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(branch_id, branch_status) %>%
  distinct()

branches_class <- branch_labels %>%
  transmute(
    Sample = branch_id,
    class  = branch_status,
    
    colibactin_positive = if_else(
      str_detect(class, "positive"),
      "SBS88 Positive Branch",
      "SBS88 Negative Branch"
    )
  )
```

### Prepare the context matrix

Truncal branches are excluded: they aggregate mutations from before the
phylogeny resolves and so are not comparable to terminal branches.

```{r context-matrix}
truncal_samples <- branches_class$Sample[branches_class$class == "Truncal"]

contexts_no_trunks <- contexts %>%
  dplyr::select(!any_of(truncal_samples)) %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ sum(.x) > 0))

# Convert counts to relative contribution (each sample sums to 1)
contexts_relative <- prop.table(as.matrix(contexts_no_trunks), margin = 2)

# Sanity check
head(colSums(contexts_relative))
```

```{r transpose-matrix}
# Samples as rows, 96 channels as columns
contexts_relative <- as.data.frame(t(contexts_relative))
```

## PCA

`scale = TRUE` standardises each of the 96 channels to unit variance, which
gives rare channels equal weight to common ones.

```{r pca}
pca_fit <- prcomp(contexts_relative, scale = TRUE)

pct_var <- round(100 * pca_fit$sdev^2 / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2), 1)
head(pct_var)
```

### Unsupervised clustering in PC space

Ward linkage on Euclidean distance over the first five PCs, cut into two
groups.

```{r clustering}
n_pcs   <- 2
n_clust <- 2

hc_pca   <- hclust(dist(pca_fit$x[, seq_len(n_pcs)]), method = "ward.D2")
clusters <- cutree(hc_pca, k = n_clust)

cluster_df <- tibble(
  Sample  = names(clusters),
  cluster = paste0("Cluster_", clusters)
)
```

### Assemble the plotting dataframe

```{r pca-df}
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  inner_join(branches_class, by = "Sample") %>%
  left_join(cluster_df, by = "Sample")
```

## Plots

### Palettes and shared theme

```{r palettes}
branch_levels <- c(
  "First positive branch", "Second positive branch", "Post cessation branch",
  "Negative Crypt",  "Pre exposure"
)

branch_col <- c(
  "First positive branch"  = "maroon4",
  "Second positive branch" = "maroon4",
  "Post cessation branch"  = "black",
  "Negative Crypt"         = "grey80",
  "Pre exposure"           = "grey80"
)

branch_alpha <- c(
  "First positive branch"  = 0.2,
  "Second positive branch" = 0.2,
  "Post cessation branch"  = 1,
  "Negative Crypt"         = 0.2,
  "Pre exposure"           = 0.2
)

# NOTE: `cutree` numbers clusters arbitrarily, so which cluster is the
# SBS88-enriched one is not guaranteed between runs or data versions.
# Check `cluster_counts` below before trusting the colour assignment.
cluster_col <- c(
  "Cluster_1" = "maroon4",
  "Cluster_2" = "grey80"
)

pca_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 12)
  )

pc_labs <- labs(
  x = paste0("PC1 (", pct_var[1], "%)"),
  y = paste0("PC2 (", pct_var[2], "%)")
)
```

### PC1 vs PC2, coloured by branch status

```{r pca-plot-branch, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
pca_plot <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = class, alpha = class)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = branch_col, breaks = branch_levels) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = branch_alpha, breaks = branch_levels) +
  guides(alpha = "none") +
  pc_labs +
  labs(colour = "Branch status") +
  pca_theme

pca_plot
```

### PC1 vs PC2, coloured by unsupervised cluster

```{r pca-plot-cluster, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
cluster_pca_plot <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_col, breaks = names(cluster_col)) +
  pc_labs +
  labs(colour = "Cluster annotation") +
  pca_theme

cluster_pca_plot
```

### Export the combined figure

```{r export-figure, results = "hide"}
dir.create("../Supplementary_Figures/", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  pca_plot, cluster_pca_plot,
  nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(1, 1)
)

ggsave("../Supplementary_Figures//PCA_Branch_Annotation.png", combined_plot, height = 12, width = 12)
```

## Agreement between clusters and SBS88 status

### Cluster membership

```{r cluster-counts}
cluster_counts <- pca_df %>%
  dplyr::count(class, cluster) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("class")

cluster_counts
```

Row percentages:

```{r cluster-percentages}
cluster_percentages <- round(100 * proportions(as.matrix(cluster_counts), margin = 1), 1)
cluster_percentages
```

### Adjusted Rand index

```{r adjusted-rand}
adjusted_rand_index <- adjustedRandIndex(pca_df$colibactin_positive, pca_df$cluster)

cat(sprintf("Adjusted Rand index: %.3f\n", adjusted_rand_index))
```

### Chi-squared test

```{r chi-squared}
sbs88_by_cluster <- table(pca_df$colibactin_positive, pca_df$cluster)
sbs88_by_cluster

chisq.test(sbs88_by_cluster)
```
```{r}
#Annotate branches type
ref_profile='First positive branch'
classes=unique(branches_class$class)
classes=c('First positive branch','Second positive branch','Post cessation branch','Negative Crypt')
classes=classes[!classes==ref_profile]

plotting_data <- array(data = 0, dim = c(96, length(classes)))
colnames(plotting_data) <- classes
plotting_data <- as.data.frame(plotting_data)


## Normalise data:
Data_Relative <- scale(contexts, center = FALSE, scale = colSums(contexts))
head(colSums(Data_Relative))
Data_Relative <- as.data.frame(t(Data_Relative))
Data_Relative <- tibble::rownames_to_column(Data_Relative,"Sample")
Data_Relative <- left_join(Data_Relative, Branches_class, by='Sample')
T_test_df     <- Data_Relative

#Calculate Averages
Branch_Average <- Data_Relative %>% group_by(class) %>% summarise_if(is.numeric, mean)
row.names(Branch_Average) = NULL
Branch_Average <- tibble::column_to_rownames(Branch_Average,"class")
Branch_Average <- as.data.frame(t(Branch_Average))
Branch_Average <- tibble::rownames_to_column(Branch_Average, var = "MutationType")
  
#Correct Order
Branch_Average$Ref <- substr(Branch_Average$MutationType, 3, 3)
Branch_Average$Mut <- substr(Branch_Average$MutationType, 5, 5)
Branch_Average <- Branch_Average[order(Branch_Average$Ref, Branch_Average$Mut),]
Branch_Average <- subset(Branch_Average, select = -c(Ref, Mut))

#Prepare to Plot
signature_data  <- Branch_Average[,sapply(Branch_Average, is.numeric)]
rownames(signature_data) <- NULL
signature_data <- signature_data*100

## generate relatives to Negatve Crypt:
for (i in 1:length(classes)){
  sig_data <- signature_data[ , c(classes[i], ref_profile)]
  
    
  #Choose columns to plot from signature_data
  #######edit######
  w <- 1
  z <- 2
    
  #Calculate differences
  a = sig_data[w]
  b = sig_data[z]
  difference_data <- tibble(a-b, .name_repair = "minimal")
  #colnames(difference_data) <- c("Difference")
    
  plotting_data[, c(classes[i])] <- difference_data
}
  

# Define Plot Function
outdir='../Supplementary_Figures/'
plot_standard_SNV_signatures = function(title, signatures_data, outdir,ref_profile,fixed_axis=FALSE, combined =FALSE){
  # title is the name of the data to be plotted e.g. PCAWG_Reference_SNV
  # signatures_data is the vector containing the signature data, ensure that this is in the standard order (see PCAWG reference signatures)
  # Ensure column names contain the desired signature title
  # plot_single argument determines if single files or combined file is ouput, by default a combined file is generated
  #fixed_axis argument determines whether plot is with fixed (5% scale) or variable axis. 
  
  # Specify Context Type
  sig_cat = c("C>A","C>G","C>T","T>A","T>C","T>G")
  ctx_vec = paste(rep(c("A","C","G","T"),each=4),rep(c("A","C","G","T"),times=4),sep="-")
  full_vec = paste(rep(sig_cat,each=16),rep(ctx_vec,times=6),sep=",")
  snv_context = paste(substr(full_vec,5,5), substr(full_vec,1,1), substr(full_vec,7,7), sep="")
  
  # Specify Vectors for plot colours
  col_vec_num <- rep(16,6)
  col_vec = rep(c("dodgerblue","black","red","grey70","olivedrab3","plum2"),each=16)
  
  # Convert to matrix
  MaxY = max(plotting_data)
  sig_plot <- as.matrix(plotting_data)
  
  # Set up Signature Names and title
  plot_title <- title
  sig_title <- colnames(plotting_data)
  
  # Plot signatures
  if(fixed_axis == TRUE && combined == FALSE) {
    for (i in 1:ncol(sig_plot)) {
      pdf(paste0(plot_title, "_", sig_title[i], ".pdf"), width=12,height=7)
      par(xaxs='i', cex = 1, xpd = FALSE)
      
      #fixed_axis length
      l = 5
      
      #  call empty plot
      b = barplot(sig_plot[,i], col = NA, border = NA, axes = FALSE, las = 2, ylim=c(-l,l), 
                  names.arg = snv_context, cex.lab = 1, cex.names = 0.70, cex.axis = 2, 
                  space = 1, ylab = "Avg. Contribution Difference (%)")  
      # add axis
      axis(2, at = pretty((-l):(l), n = 4), col = 'grey90', las = 1, cex.axis = 1.5)
      # add gridlines
      abline_pos = pretty((-l):(l), n = 4)
      abline(h = abline_pos[3], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[2], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[4], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[5], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[6], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[1], col = 'grey90')
      
      # call columns
      b = barplot(sig_plot[,i], axes = FALSE, col=col_vec, add = T, border = NA, space = 1)
      # add box surronding plot
      box(lty = 1, col = 'grey90')
      # add title
      title(paste0(sig_title[i]), line = -2, adj = 0.01, cex.main = 2)
      #add second title
      # add rectangles and ann tations on top of the plot
      par(xpd = NA)
      for (j in 1:length(sig_cat)) {
        xpos = b[c(sum(col_vec_num[1:j])-col_vec_num[j]+1,sum(col_vec_num[1:j]))]
        rect(xpos[1]-0.5, l, xpos[2]+0.5, l*1.05, border=NA, col=unique(col_vec)[j])
        text(x=mean(xpos), pos=3, y=l*1.05, label=sig_cat[j], cex = 1.25)
      } 
      par(xpd = FALSE)
      dev.off()
    } 
  } 
  
  else if(fixed_axis && combined) {
    for (i in 1:ncol(sig_plot)) {
      pdf(paste0(plot_title,".pdf"), width = 18, height = 14)
      par(mfrow = c(4,3), mar=c(5.1, 5.1, 4.1, 2.1), xaxs='i', cex = 0.75, xpd = FALSE)
      for (i in 1:length(sig_title)) {
        #fixed_axis length
        l = 5
        
        #  call empty plot
        b = barplot(sig_plot[,i], col = NA, border = NA, axes = FALSE, las = 2, ylim=c(-l,l), 
                    names.arg = snv_context, cex.lab = 1, cex.names = 0.35, cex.axis = 1, 
                    space = 1, ylab = "Average Contribution Difference (%)")  
        # add axis
        axis(2, at = pretty((-l):(l), n = 4), col = 'grey90', las = 1, cex.axis = 1)
        # add gridlines
        abline_pos = pretty((-l):(l), n = 4)
        abline(h = abline_pos[3], col = 'grey90')
        abline(h = abline_pos[2], col = 'grey90')
        abline(h = abline_pos[4], col = 'grey90')
        abline(h = abline_pos[5], col = 'grey90')
        abline(h = abline_pos[6], col = 'grey90')
        abline(h = abline_pos[1], col = 'grey90')
        
        # call columns
        b = barplot(sig_plot[,i], axes = FALSE, col=col_vec, add = T, border = NA, space = 1)
        # add box surronding plot
        box(lty = 1, col = 'grey90')
        # add title
        title(paste0(sig_title[i]), line = -l*0.85, adj = 0.01, cex.main = 1.3)
        # add rectangles and annotations on top of the plot
        par(xpd = NA)
        for (j in 1:length(sig_cat)) {
          xpos = b[c(sum(col_vec_num[1:j])-col_vec_num[j]+1,sum(col_vec_num[1:j]))]
          rect(xpos[1]-0.5, l, xpos[2]+0.5, l*1.05, border=NA, col=unique(col_vec)[j])
          text(x=mean(xpos), pos=3, y=l*1, label=sig_cat[j], cex = 0.75)
        } 
        par(xpd = FALSE)
      }
      dev.off()
    } 
    
  } else if(fixed_axis == FALSE && combined == FALSE){
    print("Variable Axis")
    for (i in 1:ncol(sig_plot)) {
      pdf(paste0(outdir,plot_title," - ",sig_title[i], ".pdf"), width=12,height=7)
      par(xaxs='i', cex = 1, xpd = FALSE)
      #  define maxy and miny
      #max_prob <- sig_plot[,i]
      maxy = max(sig_plot[,i])
      miny = -1*min(sig_plot[,i])
      # define axis length
      axis_length <- if (maxy > miny) {print(maxy)} else {print(miny)}
      
      high <- round((1.5*axis_length), digits =1)
      low <- round((-1.5*axis_length), digits = 1)
      print(high)
      print(low)
      
      #  call empty plot
      b = barplot(sig_plot[,i], col = NA, border = NA, axes = FALSE, las = 2, ylim=c(low, high), 
                  names.arg = snv_context, cex.lab = 1, cex.names = 0.70, cex.axis = 2, 
                  space = 1, ylab = "Average Contribution Difference (%)")  
      
      plot_vector <- pretty(c(low,high), n=4)
      #plot_vector <- seq(low, high, length.out = 4)
      print(plot_vector)
      # add axis
      axis(2, at = plot_vector, col = 'grey90', las = 1, cex.axis = 1.5)
      
      # add gridlines 
      abline_pos = plot_vector
      abline(h = abline_pos[1], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[2], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[3], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[4], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[5], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[6], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[7], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[8], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[9], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[10], col = 'grey90')
      
      # call columns
      b = barplot(sig_plot[,i], axes = FALSE, col=col_vec, add = T, border = NA, space = 1)
      # add box surronding plot
      box(lty = 1, col = 'grey90')
      # add title
      title(paste0(sig_title[i], " versus ", ref_profile), line = -1.5, adj = 0.01, cex.main = 2)
     
      # add rectangles and annotations on top of the plot
      par(xpd = NA)
      for (j in 1:length(sig_cat)) {
        xpos = b[c(sum(col_vec_num[1:j])-col_vec_num[j]+1,sum(col_vec_num[1:j]))]
        rect(xpos[1]-0.5, high, xpos[2]+0.5, high*1.06, border=NA, col=unique(col_vec)[j])
        text(x=mean(xpos), pos=3, y=high*1.06, label=sig_cat[j], cex = 1.25)
      } 
      par(xpd = FALSE)
      dev.off()
    } 
  }
  
  else if(fixed_axis == FALSE && combined == TRUE){
    print("Variable Axis")
    for (i in 1:ncol(sig_plot)) {
      pdf(paste0(plot_title, ".pdf"), width=12,height=7)
      par(xaxs='i', cex = 1, xpd = FALSE)
      #  define maxy and miny
      #max_prob <- sig_plot[,i]
      maxy = max(sig_plot)
      miny = -1*min(sig_plot)
      # define axis length
      axis_length <- if (maxy > miny) {print(maxy)} else {print(miny)}
      
      high <- round((1.5*axis_length), digits =1)
      low <- round((-1.5*axis_length), digits = 1)
      print(high)
      print(low)
      
      #  call empty plot
      b = barplot(sig_plot[,i], col = NA, border = NA, axes = FALSE, las = 2, ylim=c(low, high), 
                  names.arg = snv_context, cex.lab = 1, cex.names = 0.70, cex.axis = 2, 
                  space = 1, ylab = "Average Contribution Difference (%)")  
      
      plot_vector <- pretty(c(low,high), n=4)
      #plot_vector <- seq(low, high, length.out = 4)
      print(plot_vector)
      # add axis
      axis(2, at = plot_vector, col = 'grey90', las = 1, cex.axis = 1.5)
      
      # add gridlines 
      abline_pos = plot_vector
      abline(h = abline_pos[1], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[2], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[3], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[4], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[5], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[6], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[7], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[8], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[9], col = 'grey90')
      abline(h = abline_pos[10], col = 'grey90')
      
      # call columns
      b = barplot(sig_plot[,i], axes = FALSE, col=col_vec, add = T, border = NA, space = 1)
      # add box surronding plot
      box(lty = 1, col = 'grey90')
      # add title
      title(paste0(sig_title[i]), line = -1.5, adj = 0.01, cex.main = 2)
      
      # add rectangles and annotations on top of the plot
      par(xpd = NA)
      for (j in 1:length(sig_cat)) {
        xpos = b[c(sum(col_vec_num[1:j])-col_vec_num[j]+1,sum(col_vec_num[1:j]))]
        rect(xpos[1]-0.5, high, xpos[2]+0.5, high*1.06, border=NA, col=unique(col_vec)[j])
        text(x=mean(xpos), pos=3, y=high*1.06, label=sig_cat[j], cex = 1.25)
      } 
      par(xpd = FALSE)
      dev.off()
    } 
  }
}
```

Run context pairwise T-tests
```{r}
## Extract the contexts
trinuc_contexts <- colnames(T_test_df)[2:97]

# Keep only the two classes of interest
dat <- subset(
  T_test_df,
  class %in% c("Post cessation branch", "Negative Crypt")
)

# Run t-test for every trinucleotide context
results <- lapply(trinuc_contexts, function(context) {
  
  test <- t.test(dat[[context]] ~ dat$class)
  
  data.frame(
    context = context,
    mean_post_cessation = mean(
      dat[[context]][dat$class == "Post cessation branch"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_negative_crypt = mean(
      dat[[context]][dat$class == "Negative Crypt"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    t_statistic = unname(test$statistic),
    df = unname(test$parameter),
    p_value = test$p.value,
    conf_low = test$conf.int[1],
    conf_high = test$conf.int[2]
  )
})

# Combine all contexts into one table
results_df <- do.call(rbind, results)

results_df$adjp_value=p.adjust(results_df$p_value)
```
